name: Ikekan: Ikemen ni Naru ka Douka Kan de Tsukiau Game
original_name: イケ勘 イケメンになるかどうか勘で付き合うゲーム
source:
The protagonist (you) is a girl who helps out at the cafe run by her parents.
On her 20th birthday, her pet chinchilla suddenly tells her:
"The customer who comes in today is going to be handsome, so why don't you try dating him based on your intuition?"
And so, she begins a trial relationship with a guy she just met, based on her intuition...
Will her boyfriend become handsome, or...?
A fast-paced, chaotic romantic comedy game.
